root.click_here: Click here to show the full list on kobool.com.
root.list_footer: To contact whom you have acceptance towards them for marriage, please visit their Kobool pages and click the "Acceptance" button. Then, wait for the next "Acceptance Matching" to match you with one of whom you added to your "Acceptance List" if he/she also added you to his/her "Acceptance List". It will pick the higher rank if multiple mutual acceptance were found.

new_questions.footer: To answer these quesions, click here and sign in to your Kobool account.
